title: Ising with prime couplings
plain: On the integer line, couple spins i and j with strength 1 if i − j is prime. Decide whether there is a phase transition.
math: For the 1D Ising model with $J_{ij}=\mathbf 1[|i-j|\in\mathbb{P}]\,|i-j|^{-2}$, prove a phase transition at finite $\beta_c$ and determine whether the magnetization jumps.
